sentences.text: A lax standard of evidence, unfortunately, can allow a weak argument to circulate freely, and false information, a predator of honest debate, can drown a careful voice before a scholar may respond.
sentences.translation: 不幸的是,宽松的证据标准会让站不住脚的论证自由流传,而虚假信息——诚实辩论的掠夺者——能在学者回应之前淹没理性的声音。

sentences.text: In the modern cosmopolitan world, the mandate of a university is to cultivate independent judgement, a skill that can trace its root to the old tradition of antiquity, and entrepreneurial energy can combine with rigorous scholarship, provided that honest inquiry remains the priority and no one may grudge a colleague his success.
sentences.translation: 在当今世界主义的现代社会,大学的使命是培养独立判断力——这种能力可以追溯到古代的辩论传统;而创业精神也可以与严谨的学术相结合,前提是诚实探究始终是首要之事,且没有人会嫉妒同事的成功。

grammar.name: provided that 引导条件状语从句
grammar.note: provided that 表示"前提是、只要",提出合作成立的条件,语气正式。
grammar.example: You may join us, provided that you keep quiet.

lessonGrammar.name: 观点论述框架
lessonGrammar.note: 文章先总述框架,再用冒号列举三部分(引言、主体、结论),是观点论述文的经典结构。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: Every persuasive essay can rest on a clear framework: an introduction that may state the position, a body that may develop a reason, and a conclusion that may reinforce the thesis.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 每篇有说服力的议论文都建立在清晰的框架之上:引言陈述立场,主体展开理由,结论强化论点。

lessonGrammar.name: 冒号引出并列成分
lessonGrammar.note: 冒号后的三个并列名词短语均带 that 定语从句,句式对称整齐。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: Every persuasive essay can rest on a clear framework: an introduction that may state the position, a body that may develop a reason, and a conclusion that may reinforce the thesis.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 每篇有说服力的议论文都建立在清晰的框架之上:引言陈述立场,主体展开理由,结论强化论点。

lessonGrammar.name: rest on 搭配
lessonGrammar.note: rest on 表示"依赖于、建立在……之上",是学术英语的高频搭配。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: Every persuasive essay can rest on a clear framework: an introduction that may state the position, a body that may develop a reason, and a conclusion that may reinforce the thesis.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 每篇有说服力的议论文都建立在清晰的框架之上:引言陈述立场,主体展开理由,结论强化论点。

lessonGrammar.name: 比较级 less... than...
lessonGrammar.note: less than 表示"不如……",用于比较两项能力的重要程度,是观点论述常用的比较句式。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: In a debate, however, the mastery of this framework can matter less than the ability to anticipate an objection and neutralize it with solid evidence.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 然而,在辩论中,对框架的掌握不如"预见反对意见并用扎实的证据加以化解"的能力重要。

lessonGrammar.name: 不定式短语作定语
lessonGrammar.note: the ability to anticipate... and neutralize... 中,两个不定式并列修饰 ability,说明能力的具体内容。
